key_insight: LoRA can be treated as a controlled probe of exact parametric memory, revealing a power-law scaling between memory gain, effective parameters, and sequence length.
engineering_relevance: The paper offers a practical way to predict and improve LLM finetuning memory retention, which can make continual knowledge updates more efficient and reliable.
method: Quantify exact parametric memory using LoRA in the latent space.
Fit a Parametric Memory Law: loss reduction ΔL follows a robust power law with effective parameters and sequence length.
Use token-level analysis to identify a phase transition and guide MemFT to focus training on sub-threshold tokens.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical evaluations showing that MemFT improves both memory fidelity and training efficiency.
watch_item: The threshold rule p > 0.5 is derived under greedy decoding, so behavior may differ with other decoding settings or non-verbatim tasks.
paper_title: How LoRA Remembers? A Parametric Memory Law for LLM Finetuning
